question: Which records have not been modified since before the selected window?

steps.name: records
steps.soql: SELECT Id, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name FROM {obj} WHERE LastModifiedDate < LAST_N_DAYS:{days} ORDER BY LastModifiedDate ASC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {records.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: Old records can be valid reference or historical data. This is not a deletion list.
The object must support the selected modification fields; query limits may omit other records.
